info.name: CoinGecko Crypto Market Data Asset Platforms Contract API
Get coin data by contract address

params.name: id
params.description: The asset platform ID (e.g., ethereum, polygon-pos, solana)

params.name: contract_address
params.description: The token contract address on the asset platform

items.docs: Get comprehensive coin data by querying a contract address on a specific asset platform. Returns the same data as the /coins/{id} endpoint.

info.name: Get coin market chart data by contract address

params.name: id
params.description: The asset platform ID (e.g., ethereum, polygon-pos, solana)

params.name: contract_address
params.description: The token contract address on the asset platform

params.name: vs_currency
params.description: The target currency for market data

params.name: days
params.description: Number of days of historical data

params.name: precision
params.description: Decimal precision for currency price values

items.docs: Get historical market data including price, market cap, and 24h volume by querying a contract address on a specific asset platform.

info.name: Get coin market chart range data by contract address

params.name: id
params.description: The asset platform ID (e.g., ethereum, polygon-pos, solana)

params.name: contract_address
params.description: The token contract address on the asset platform

params.name: vs_currency
params.description: The target currency for market data

params.name: precision
params.description: Decimal precision for currency price values

items.docs: Get historical market data for a specific contract address within a custom date range specified by UNIX timestamps.
